name: campaign_07_chevron_sieve
description: A large continuous intestinal field, entered at four separate left-edge breaches. Forward-moving streams cover upper, middle, and lower approaches. Two wall-attached folds and a central tissue island bend streams toward separate broad right exits. There is no central interchange. The organ lies beyond the right edge.

editor.notes: Approved intestinal field: four ordered left breaches feed one broad basin. Dorsal and ventral folds attach to surrounding tissue; one enlarged central island gives upper/lower shoulders. Two broad right mouths lead to one hidden primary organ rectangle. Parallel fans keep routes in their sectors rather than crossing at a hub. Early waves use two then three sectors; every port and shoulder variant is used in later homogeneous bursts, with 1.25s air gaps per marker.
